title: Months Counted in a Vision Termination Credit — Premium Billing Accounts
content:
**Clause.** In the termination credit for a vision plan unit on Premium Billing Accounts, the months counted depend on how the account is billed. The cases are read in order; the first that applies decides.

**Case A — prepaid year.** On an arrangement that carries a prepay discount (only Cascade Individual Annual Prepay, at 4 percent) and has issued a twelve-month invoice within twelve months before the credit date, only the prepaid months count: the whole calendar months from the unit's termination date to the account's paid-through date (never fewer than zero), because months beyond the paid-through date are corrected when the coming year is paid. An account with no paid-through date on record is taken under the cases that follow instead.

**Case B — returned automatic draft during grace.** On an account in a grace period whose automatic draft — a returned payment by bank draft (EFT) that had paid one, three or twelve coverage months, its latest return being the one dated last — was returned on or after the grace-period start date, the automatic draft stays suspended and the invoice issued last is collected with the grace-cure payment, so every month billed after the termination month counts: the whole calendar months from the month after the month of the termination date through the coverage month of the invoice issued last (of two issued on the same day, the one recorded first), zero when there is no invoice or that month is not later than the termination month.

**Case C — otherwise.** The months counted are the months billed after the termination month that have begun: the whole calendar months from the unit's termination date to the credit date, plus one, never fewer than zero and never more than the months billed after the termination month.

**Months covered on the credit.** The credit's months covered are the months counted under this clause less the months already credited, never fewer than zero. The months already credited are the months covered by termination credits on the vision line booked since the unit's termination month, a credit counting as booked since that month when the whole calendar months from its booking date to the credit date are no more than the whole calendar months from the unit's termination date to the credit date.

Whole calendar months are counted the way an anniversary is counted (a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it). A record counts as falling within a number of months before the credit date when the whole calendar months from its date to the credit date, counted the way an anniversary is counted (a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it), are fewer than that number.

**Hypothetical cases** (termination date 31 March; invoice issued last for July; credit date 10 May; no earlier vision termination credit).
| Account | Months counted | Months covered |
|---|---|---|
| Annual Prepay, twelve-month invoice within twelve months, paid through 31 December | 31 March to 31 December: 9 | 9 |
| Monthly account in grace, a one-month EFT draft returned after the grace-period start date | April through July: 4 | 4 |
| Monthly account, no such draft return | 1 complete month plus one: 2 | 2 |
| As the last row, but a vision termination credit covering 1 month booked on 20 April | 2 | 1 |
